sloka: शिति कण्ठस्य विष्णोः च बल अबल निरीक्षया ।अभिप्रायम् तु विज्ञाय देवतानाम् पितामहः ॥१-७५-१५॥
transliteration: śiti kaṇṭhasya viṣṇoḥ ca bala abala nirīkṣayā ।abhiprāyam tu vijñāya devatānām pitāmahaḥ ॥1-75-15॥

translations.english: Foremost among the truthful, Grandsire Brahma come to know the intention of the gods and triggered a conflict between the gods.
